## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no generated output.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] README and CLI help remain consistent.
- [ ] CHANGELOG includes a user-visible entry when needed.
- [ ] OpenSpec requirements are updated when public behavior changes.
- [ ] Output safety and compatibility implications were considered.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unrelated files are included.
